mail.tpl.invitation.subject: Invitation to a gift exchange
mail.tpl.invitation.p1: You are invited to take part in the gift exchange "{group}".
mail.tpl.invitation.link: Here is your personal link to join the exchange:
mail.tpl.invitation.code: Your personal code, to enter if you are asked for it: {code}
mail.tpl.invitation.keep: Keep this link and this code to yourself: they only work for you.
mail.tpl.ready_one.subject: Your draw is ready
mail.tpl.ready_one.p1: The draw for the exchange "{group}" is done: you have one gift to prepare.
mail.tpl.ready_one.link: Find out your draw with your personal link:
mail.tpl.ready_one.letter: Remember to write your own letter to Santa too, to guide the person who will give you a gift.
mail.tpl.ready_two.subject: Your draw is ready: your two gifts
mail.tpl.ready_two.p1: The draw for the exchange "{group}" is done: you have two gifts to prepare.
mail.tpl.ready_two.link: Find out your draw with your personal link:
mail.tpl.ready_two.letter: Remember to write your own letter to Santa too, to guide the person who will give you a gift.
mail.tpl.ready_reception.subject: The draw is done
mail.tpl.ready_reception.p1: The draw for the exchange "{group}" is done: you will receive a gift.
mail.tpl.ready_reception.letter: You have no gift to give this time. Write your letter to Santa to guide the person who will give you one.
mail.tpl.ready_reception.link: Here is your personal link to write your letter:
mail.tpl.magic_link.subject: Your sign-in link
mail.tpl.magic_link.p1: Here is your sign-in link for the gift exchange "{group}".
mail.tpl.magic_link.link: This link is valid for 15 minutes and works only once:
mail.tpl.magic_link.ignore: If you did not ask for it, simply ignore this message.
mail.tpl.letter_updated.subject: A letter to Santa has changed
mail.tpl.letter_updated.p1: The letter of the person you give a gift to has just been updated in the exchange "{group}".
mail.tpl.letter_updated.link: To read it, open your personal link:
mail.tpl.draw_adjusted.subject: Your draw has been adjusted
mail.tpl.draw_adjusted.p1: The draw for the exchange "{group}" has been adjusted by the organiser.
mail.tpl.draw_adjusted.link: Your draw has changed: open your personal link to find it out again:
mail.tpl.draw_adjusted.old: Your previous draw is no longer valid, please disregard it entirely.
mail.tpl.reminder_participant.subject: A little reminder about your exchange
mail.tpl.reminder_participant.p1: A little reminder: the organiser of the exchange "{group}" is still waiting for your participation.
mail.tpl.reminder_participant.link: Get back to the exchange with your personal link:
mail.tpl.reminder_letter.subject: Remember to write your letter to Santa
mail.tpl.reminder_letter.p1: Your letter to Santa is still empty in the exchange "{group}". A few ideas are enough to help the person who will give you a gift.
mail.tpl.reminder_letter.link: Write your letter with your personal link:
mail.tpl.reminder_reading.subject: Your draw is waiting for you
mail.tpl.reminder_reading.p1: The draw for the exchange "{group}" is done, but you have not found out your result yet.
mail.tpl.reminder_reading.link: Open your personal link to read it:
mail.tpl.verification.subject: Your verification code
mail.tpl.verification.p1: To complete your registration for the exchange "{group}", please confirm your address.
mail.tpl.verification.link: You can also confirm with a single click:
mail.tpl.verification.validity: The code and the link are valid for 15 minutes.
mail.tpl.welcome.subject: Welcome to the gift exchange
mail.tpl.welcome.p1: Your registration for the exchange "{group}" is confirmed, welcome!
mail.tpl.welcome.link: Here is your personal link, keep it safe:
mail.tpl.welcome.letter: Take a moment to write your letter to Santa: a few ideas will help the person who will give you a gift.
mail.tpl.budget_updated.subject: The exchange budget has changed
mail.tpl.budget_updated.p1: The budget of the exchange "{group}" was changed by the organiser.
mail.tpl.budget_updated.amount: The new suggested budget per gift is {budget}.
mail.tpl.budget_updated.none: There is no longer a fixed budget for this exchange.
mail.tpl.footer.why.participant: You receive this message because your address is among the participants of the gift exchange "{group}".
mail.tpl.footer.why.reminder: You receive this message because you take part in the gift exchange "{group}" and the organiser sends reminders.
mail.tpl.footer.why.letter: You receive this message because you give a gift in the exchange "{group}" and new ideas are reported to those who give.
mail.tpl.footer.why.login: You receive this message because your address was used to sign in or register for the gift exchange "{group}".
mail.tpl.footer.sender: This message is sent automatically by the {app} application, on behalf of the group "{group}".
mail.tpl.footer.unsubscribe.relances: To stop receiving reminders of this kind, use this link:
mail.tpl.footer.unsubscribe.nouvelle_ide: To stop being told about new ideas, use this link:
